_notes: Coordinates are in universe units: 0..MAX_X_UNIVERSE. Divide by 10 for the coordinates the game shows (e.g. Sol 1752,1450 is 175.2, 145.0).

Star names are content, not code. name_postfix is an index into the game strings (STAR_STRING_BASE, gamestrings.txt), name_prefix 0 means none, otherwise index-1 into the Greek-letter numbers at STAR_NUMBER_BASE. See GetClusterName in starmap.c.
special names the generator in planets/generate/ for special systems; null means an ordinary system made by gendefault.c.
The random seed of a system is MAKE_DWORD (x, y) (GetRandomSeedForStar in planets/solarsys.c).
quasispace lists the QuasiSpace portal exits and the Arilou homeworld, in QuasiSpace coordinates.
